sentences.l2: 救急の現場では、一分一秒が患者の命に関わる。
sentences.l1: At emergency scenes, every minute and every second concerns a patient's life.

sentences.l2: 事故などで大きな外傷を受けた人が運ばれてくると、医者や看護師はすぐに体の状態を調べ、必要な処置を始める。
sentences.l1: When a person who has suffered a major injury in an accident or the like is brought in, doctors and nurses immediately examine the condition of the body and start the necessary treatment.

sentences.l2: この時、一人一人が自分の役割を確実に果たすことが重要だ。
sentences.l1: At this time, it is important that each and every person reliably fulfills their own role.

sentences.l2: だれが何をするかを前もって決めておくことで、慌てずに素早く動くことができる。
sentences.l1: By deciding in advance who will do what, they can move quickly without panicking.

sentences.l2: 救急医療は、こうしたチームの力によって支えられている。
sentences.l1: Emergency medicine is supported by the power of such teams.
